string.text: {=mfyline500}There's nothing as stupid as introducing myself in this place, 'Hey, I'm nobleman.'
{=mfyline501}But that's how I introduce myself. It's only lack of gold, but it's not pride.
{=mfyline502}I do aim to restore the glory of my old family with my brother. Even though I have never experienced old glory myself.
{=mfyline503}Anyway, my eldest brother remains in charge, and I am, I don't know. It would be easy to understand if I said I was on a business trip.
{=mfyline504}You haven't abandoned your ideals.
{=mfyline505}You want to be treated like a noble?
{=mfyline506}I understand my current situation very well. I'm not a tactless idiot. I've never even been lived like a noble in the first place.
{=mfyline510}I was a body guard of a lord.
{=mfyline511}So, there's a place I have to go back.
{=mfyline512}Oh, please don't misunderstand me as a deserter. My last role was to be a derelict bait so that my lord could get away safely.
{=mfyline513}So I'm a person who's either dead or should be held or not existed.
{=mfyline514}You were a soldier faithful to your duties.
{=mfyline515}But don't you think should go back? Maybe the lord had no choice.
{=mfyline516}I was prepared to die, but I wasn't. But the person who tried to survive didn't seem to be lucky. In fact, if there was somewhere to go back, I would have gone long ago.
{=mfyline520}I'm a hunter, but it's not just a hunt for food.
{=mfyline521}It's a hunt to solve the problem. You can call it the bounty hunter. Oh, of course, I only hunt animals.
{=mfyline522}Wild boars or wolves, which mainly attack houses and farms, are my main targets.
{=mfyline523}I accidentally kill an animal that nobleman valued. I'm taking a break from work until the incident goes quiet.
{=mfyline524}Didn't you go hunting on commission? Then there wouldn't have been a problem.
{=mfyline525}The difference between hunters and illegal poachers is not that big.
{=mfyline526}I think I've been caught in someone's trap. I'm a problem solver, and I didn't want to cause a problem.
